test_title: PYST 48: SSC GD Constable 2024 - Quantitative Aptitude (Held On: 06 Mar, 2024 Shift 4)
subject: maths
question: A person borrowed Rs. 10000 on compound interest at the rate of 20 percent per annum. If the interest is compounded half yearly, then what will be the amount to be paid after 1 year?
solution:
**Given:**

Principal (P) = Rs. 10000

Annual Interest Rate (R) = 20%

Time (T) = 1 year

Compounding frequency = Half yearly

**Formula Used:**

Compound Interest Formula: A = P (1 + (R)/(100n))ⁿt

Where,

A = Amount

P = Principal

R = Annual Interest Rate

n = Number of times interest applied per time period

t = Number of time periods the money is invested for

**Calculation:**

Here, n = 2 (since interest is compounded half yearly)

t = 1 year

Substitute the values into the formula:

⇒ A = 10000 (1 + (20)/(100 × 2))² × ¹

⇒ A = 10000 (1 + (20)/(200))²

⇒ A = 10000 (1 + 0.1)²

⇒ A = 10000 (1.1)²

⇒ A = 10000 (1.21)

⇒ A = 12100

**The amount to be paid after 1 year is Rs. 12100.**
